_comment: Advisories scripts/ci/audit.sh pnpm may ignore. Every entry needs id (CVE or GHSA), reason and expires (YYYY-MM-DD); an expired entry fails the lane. Only an advisory with no fixed release reachable from our consumers belongs here — anything with a fix is pinned through pnpm.overrides in the root package.json instead (CLAUDE.md §9).

allow.reason: node-forge RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 verification accepts extra DigestAlgorithm elements; no fixed release exists upstream (patched <0.0.0). Reachable only transitively via Expo CLI build tooling, never for signature verification of untrusted input.

braces mishandles unclosed extended glob syntax; no fixed release exists upstream (patched <0.0.0). Reachable only transitively via Expo metro file-map globbing of local project files, never on untrusted input.
